chunks.summary: Lennert Van Geert is a Belgian web and mobile developer born in October 2004, residing in Wichelen, Belgium. He is fluent in Dutch and English, enjoys bouldering, gaming, reading, and has a keen interest in space and time, with a particular fondness for Christopher Nolan films, especially "Interstellar."

They completed pre-university education at Sint-Jozefschool Mere, specializing in Business Economics and Modern Sciences from 2016 to 2022.

chunks.summary: This portfolio showcases various personal projects, including web apps like Laura's Portfolio and The Mol Quiz, as well as interactive experiences such as the Defcon IoT escape room and 3D games like Whisker Wings. Key technologies used across these projects include React, TypeScript, Blender, and IoT development, highlighting skills in web development, game design, and 3D modeling.
